about: The tap lifecycle's delays — the rest between material taps, the FLC hold, the capture window — run on the AUDIO clock, so file playback, which advances audio faster or slower than real time, moves them with the audio. AT1–AT6 advance only audio, through the path audio takes, so a delay on the wall clock would not fire. AT7–AT8 are the capture's safety timeout, which runs on the WALL clock by design (it exists for when the audio stops, and the audio clock stops with it) and measures the silence since the last chunk: the analyzer's wall clock moves only at {"stall": seconds}, wall time with no audio. Each starts a fresh analyzer (threshold −40, Taps 1) and runs the shared steps of tooling/analyzer-steps (settings, setTaps, newTap, guitarTap, materialTap, accept, advance — with 'level' and 'extra' — audioChunks, two loud chunks being a tap the analyzer detects, and stall), plus {"fileEnd": true} (the file ends: what the engine calls), {"playingFile": true} (the engine reports a file playing), {"noteWarmup": true} (remembers when the warm-up started) and {"check": {...}}. Fields: 'detecting', 'phase' (Swift's raw value), 'complete', 'gatedCapture' (a capture is filling), 'aboveThreshold' (the level latch is up), 'warmupAtLastChunk' (the warm-up started at the audio time of the last chunk), 'warmupUnchanged' (the warm-up start is the one noted). Expected values are Swift's.

cases.note: between taps of a plate phase, detection rests a tap cooldown of audio
after fC is accepted, the FLC phase arms a tap cooldown of audio later, its warm-up from the chunk that ended the hold
the file's end releases the pending capture window — the audio clock stops with the file
the file's end does not release a pending rest — it ends when its audio has passed
a tap detected from the audio turns detection off
playing a file, a phase's last tap advances to the next phase at once, latched above and without restarting the warm-up
a capture the audio stops filling is closed by the safety timeout once 2 s pass with no audio; detection then rests and re-arms as after any capture
the safety timeout measures the silence since the last chunk, not the time since the capture opened: one quiet chunk every 0.4 s, for 2.8 s, leaves the capture open
